implementation.routing: Reserved canonical host-run key contains opaque handle, application launch ID and roster revision. Malformed or missing/replaced selections never reach legacy run APIs. Current context is captured/rechecked around discovery and observations.
implementation.progress: Existing TeamProvisioningProgress DTO uses original Host admission time and actual Host observation time. Missing/invalid old timestamps refuse instead of using renderer Date.now. Pending native/context/human, unknown custody, partial failure and confirmed stopped outcomes remain distinct; no invented PID/logs or readiness.
implementation.subscription: Existing onProvisioningProgress callback shares the Team observation loop. No parallel timer/queue or business-state cache. Long bootstrap remains observed after initial store polling. Timestamp-only observations deduplicate; new subscribers receive a current projection. Failed owners are isolated and late results after context change/unsubscribe are discarded.
implementation.readOrder: Direct status reads and callback observations share launch read-order metadata in the existing TeamProductReadOrder. Newer reads or mutation boundaries invalidate older observations, including a late pre-stop ready result. The capture guard is checked again after the async capture returns.
implementation.cancel: All target member generations are captured before the first stop. Cancellation does not reread into a replacement and continues independent original members after refusal. Physical release must be confirmed; failures retain unknown outcome. Later status reads do not interrupt already-dispatched cleanup.
implementation.aggregate: Skipped members remain in the expected roster and need no native allocation; an otherwise ready Team reaches ready. Empty/all-skipped rosters cannot invent readiness. Aggregate admission timestamp survives polling/replay/reconstruction; older records use original claimed attempt time if aggregate time was never stored.
